inlines.v: AM'ENT, noun [Latin amentum, a thong, or strap.] A botany, a species of inflorescence, from a common, chaffy receptacle; or consisting of many scales, ranged along a stalk or slender axis, which is the common receptacle; as in birch, oak, chestnut.
